name: Sweep & reclaim (fade) at the overnight high / low with order flow
why: Stops cluster just beyond the overnight high / low; aggressors who push through it and cannot hold beyond it (the bar closes back inside) are trapped, and their exits plus the resting liquidity that absorbed them drive price back across the box. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes.md).
